description: Two hooks. On UserPromptSubmit, note the time of every message a person sends, ignoring the ones that arrive from background tasks, other sessions and schedules. When the pause before a message is longer than the threshold, read the transcripts of the sessions that were working around the absence and hand Claude one paragraph: how long the user was away, whether the machine restarted, which sessions stalled and why, which ones ended with a question. In every other prompt it reads one small file and stays silent. On StopFailure, write down which session failed and with which error, so a usage limit or an expired login is known for certain rather than guessed from the transcript later.
